title: Release Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 RC1
summary: nssalian proposed release candidate 1 (commit e8d0f0f3, tag apache-iceberg-1.12.0-rc1) as Apache Iceberg 1.12.0, with a 72-hour vote. Voters verified checksums, signatures, licenses and builds. GGraziadei voted +1 and repeated a finding from RC0: reading variant columns throws NoSuchMethodError when commons-lang3 older than 3.13 is on the classpath, because iceberg-parquet uses Streams.of(Iterable) without declaring the dependency. It also exists in 1.11.0, is tracked in issue #18164, and he asked for the fix to be included if a new RC is made. nssalian replied that since it is not a regression it can be patched into the respective branches after the release. szehon-ho asked that PR #18069, another pre-existing issue, be included if there is another RC, and voted +1. The bundle contains no result message for this RC.

positions.stance: Votes +1; the variant NoSuchMethodError with commons-lang3 older than 3.13 is not a regression and should not block, but the fix should be included if a new RC is cut.
Because the issue is not a regression and depends on the commons-lang3 version, it can be fixed with a patch to the respective branches after the release.
PR #18069 fixes another pre-existing issue that is not worth stopping this RC for but should be included if another RC is made.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. The messages show +1 votes only: one marked binding (liurenjie1024), three marked non-binding and one unmarked; no -1 votes.
